## What's new

- **Update check and self-update.** Once a day, in the background, howtui reads the newest version from the GitHub
  release page (start-up never waits). When a new release exists, the status line shows `[vX.Y.Z available]` on the next
  start. Click it, type `/update`, or use **Check for updates** in Settings (Ctrl+O) and press Enter: howtui quits,
  downloads the release for your platform, verifies it against `SHA256SUMS`, replaces itself and asks you to run it again.
  `howtui --check-update` (exit 0, 10, 11) and `howtui --update` (exit 0, 1, 11) do the same from a terminal. `cargo install`
  and Homebrew copies are left alone; howtui prints the command to use instead. Turn the check off with
  `HOWTUI_NO_UPDATE_CHECK=1` or `update.check = false`. See [Update](https://github.com/hungryZoo/howtui#update).
- **Folder listing in `ls -al` style.** When turned on (Ctrl+F), the listing now carries hidden entries, permissions and
  modification times, so *"make the script without exec permission executable"* picks the right file. Owner and group,
  link targets, the folder path and file contents are still never sent. See
  [Folder listing](https://github.com/hungryZoo/howtui#folder-listing).
- `howtui doctor` reports whether a newer release exists and how this copy would be updated.

## Upgrading from 0.1.0 or 0.1.1

Those versions have no update check. Run the install command once; later releases can then update themselves.

```bash
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hungryZoo/howtui/main/scripts/install.sh | sh     # Linux, macOS
```

```powershell
irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hungryZoo/howtui/main/scripts/install.ps1 | iex           # Windows
```

Sign-in, model choice and shell integration stay as they are.

## Verify

`sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS --ignore-missing` and `gh attestation verify <file> --repo hungryZoo/howtui`.
Binaries are not code-signed or notarized.
